topic: Hybrid training+harness concept for near-complete B0-B6 coverage after run 3 -- every identified bug/gap given a concrete resolution path (training-side or harness-side), per owner directive

chatgpt_bridge_status_honest.checked: 5 direct checks of stern.py chatgpt-login-status over roughly 10 minutes, all consistent: eingeloggt=false, chatgpt_cookies_gefunden=0. Not a transient blip -- stable across the whole window this concept was developed in.
chatgpt_bridge_status_honest.consequence: The requested ChatGPT-swarm iteration (multiple real rounds, cross-checked against an independent LLM) could not happen -- the bridge was not available at any point during this task. What follows is Claude-only iterative self-critique instead: three real rounds of draft -> find-the-weak-point -> refine, each one grounded in freshly checked real data (not assumption), documented honestly below rather than silently presented as if ChatGPT had reviewed it.
chatgpt_bridge_status_honest.ready_for_when_the_bridge_returns: BATCH_PROMPTS_FOR_CHATGPT_REVIEW_20260827.json in this packet directory -- concrete, single-line, information-dense prompts asking ChatGPT specifically to stress-test this concept's two most load-bearing and least-verified claims (see 'open_verification_items' below), not to re-derive it from scratch. Ready to fire the moment stern.py chatgpt-login-status shows a stable eingeloggt=true.

self_critique_rounds.draft: Initial framing: two separate problems, (a) a missing-format-prefix bug affecting several families, (b) B1/B5 genuinely unexplained non-movers needing more/different training data.
self_critique_rounds.weakness_found: Checked B1/B5's actual raw V2 outputs (not just the aggregate correct-count) before accepting 'unexplained'. Finding: B5 V1 always outputs a bare 'C' regardless of the real target (265/267/284/295 -- all different numbers); B5 V2 outputs the EXACT correct number every time, just missing the ABI_ACCEPTED_ORDINAL: prefix. B5 is not unexplained at all -- it's the identical missing-prefix bug already understood from B2_PRIOR_OVERRIDE, previously masked because the aggregate 'correct' metric only counts exact full-string matches.
self_critique_rounds.revision: Corrected: B5 moves from 'unexplained gap' to 'same understood format bug, needs the same fix'. B1 remains genuinely messier (see round 2).

self_critique_rounds.draft: With B5 explained, re-examined B1's raw outputs specifically for a pattern rather than assuming 'more training data' would fix it.
self_critique_rounds.weakness_found: B1 outputs (both V1 and V2) are dominated by literal fragments of a DIFFERENT family's vocabulary: 'ALLOW', 'DENY', 'EVIDENCE', and even full echoed 'EVIDENCE: No integer value is recorded.\nQUERY: ...' text -- B0_READ_BASELINE's format, not B1's own. This is real cross-family confusion (the model substituting a different, unrelated family's task shape), not a format-prefix issue, and not something the B2_PRIOR_OVERRIDE-style fix touches at all. Proposing 'add more B1 training data' without understanding this would very likely not have worked -- same lesson as the earlier B3 finding (surface/vocabulary confusion, not exposure count, is usually the real driver here).
self_critique_rounds.revision: B1 needs a different, targeted fix (see 'B1_specific_note' below) or -- per owner's explicit new instruction -- can be handled by the deterministic route entirely, sidestepping the need to solve the confusion in the model at all.

self_critique_rounds.draft: Given B1/B5's real causes, and given the owner's explicit direction to seriously evaluate a deterministic/harness-side resolution for any family the model doesn't reliably learn -- checked whether the CORRECT ANSWER for the currently-broken families (and even some working ones) is actually computable directly from the prompt's own text, without any model judgment at all.
self_critique_rounds.weakness_found_and_confirmed: Directly read real prompt templates (not assumed) for 9 of the 16 families. Every one of the 9 checked states its own ground-truth rule explicitly and completely in the prompt text: B0_WRITE/B1/B4/B5 give an explicit CODEBOOK 'KEY=>VALUE' lookup table; B0_READ gives an explicit numeric value + comparison predicate; B2_PRIOR_OVERRIDE/B2_MID_EPISODE_REMAP/B2_STALE_BINDING_REJECTION explicitly label which codebook block is 'current, authoritative' or mark itself 'STALE_REJECTED'; B3 (both variants) gives an explicit pointer/link graph to traverse; B6_GWT (both variants) states the selection rule in the prompt itself ('the candidate with the strictly highest discriminator score wins... ties broken alphabetically'). None of these require learned semantic judgment -- they require exact parsing and arithmetic/graph execution, which is exactly what LLMs (especially a lightly-tuned 0.8B) are comparatively weak at and deterministic code is perfect at.
self_critique_rounds.revision: This reframes the whole curriculum, not just the broken families: most of B0-B6 was never actually a good fit for 'teach a small model to do this by example' in the first place -- it's mechanically computable. The three plausible exceptions (B6_DB_VS_SIM, B6_CLAUDE_HANDOFF_REENTRY, B6_HYPERPOSITION_EVIDENCE_AUTHORITY) require classifying natural-language descriptions of evidence provenance/epistemic status -- not confirmed to have an equally clean stated rule, genuinely the best current candidates for real learned judgment. This is also exactly where the model already performs best (80-88% on two of the three), which is internally consistent, not a coincidence: the model is doing comparatively well precisely on the sub-tasks that actually require semantic judgment, and comparatively badly on the ones that require precise mechanical execution it was never well-suited for.

concrete_hybrid_design.integration_point: A new pre-model step in the existing xeno_shell pipeline, before XENO_MODEL_SLOT invocation. Fits the Master Spec's own already-permitted shell actions ('construct read-only projections', 'decode/validate Xeno symbol/packet output') and its section 17 'engine mode 5: deterministic/no-model path' -- not a new architectural category, an instance of one already designed for.
concrete_hybrid_design.how_it_works: For each incoming COGNITIVE_WORK_PACKET, cheaply pattern-match the prompt against known templated shapes (regex on literal markers like 'CODEBOOK:', 'CODEBOOK (entry points):', 'LEXICON (entry points):', 'LINK_SEQUENCE', 'STALE_REJECTED', 'discriminator scores', 'EVIDENCE:'/'QUERY:'). If a shape matches, run the matching deterministic solver instead of calling the model at all; the result is emitted as a DETERMINISTIC_CONTROL_RESULT packet (a class already reserved in xeno_shell_packets_v1.py specifically for real deterministic components, higher authority than a model CANDIDATE by existing schema design -- no schema change needed). If no shape matches (a genuinely novel/free-form prompt), fall through to the model exactly as today.

per_family_solvers.logic: Regex-extract all 'KEY=>VALUE' pairs from the CODEBOOK block. Extract the queried KEY from the STATE/QUERY line. Return the mapped VALUE verbatim (already in ABI_ACCEPTED_ORDINAL:N or class-word form -- the resolver never has a format-prefix bug because it copies the literal token from the prompt, it does not generate one).
per_family_solvers.confidence: VERIFIED against real prompt text this session, not assumed

per_family_solvers.logic: Regex-extract every 'KEY=>TARGET' pair from both the CODEBOOK (entry points) and CHAIN (pointer definitions)/LINK_SEQUENCE blocks into a directed graph. Start from the queried entry point (from STATE), follow edges until reaching an ABI_ACCEPTED_ORDINAL:N leaf (return it) or a cycle/UNDEFINED_* dead end (return UNRESOLVABLE).

Check for an explicit STALE_REJECTED marker first (return STALE_REJECTED if present). Otherwise identify the codebook block explicitly labeled current/authoritative (ignore any block explicitly labeled reference-only/not-current), apply any explicit UPDATE statement in stated order, then look up the queried class in the resulting table.

Extract the recorded integer and the comparison predicate (even/odd/greater-than-N/not-greater-than-N/etc.) via a small fixed set of NL patterns, evaluate, map to ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN (ABSTAIN when no value is recorded).
per_family_solvers.confidence: VERIFIED prompt shape; predicate-phrasing coverage needs a real enumeration pass over the actual generator's template set before being trusted as complete -- flagged, not assumed exhaustive

per_family_solvers.logic: Extract 'X=N' score pairs (and, for CAUSAL_REENTRY, the nested round-1-winner-selects-round-2-table structure) and the literal selection rule text already present in the prompt; compute argmax with the stated tiebreak.

families_kept_for_the_model_run_3_focus.why: Classifies a natural-language description of evidence provenance (DB query vs. simulation vs. stale rebase) -- not confirmed to reduce to a stated closed-form rule the way the others do. Currently 39% correct; real headroom, real candidate for concentrated data budget.

Similarly classifies assertion provenance from natural language. Currently the STRONGEST family (88% correct) -- evidence the model is comparatively good at genuine judgment tasks; worth reinforcing, not abandoning.

Judging whether majority-vote-type pressure should collapse or preserve Hyperposition branches. Currently 80% correct -- second-strongest. Plausibly closer to a fixed rule than it looks (the project's own stated law is 'majority does not collapse branches') -- this is exactly the kind of claim to send to ChatGPT for cross-check once the bridge is back, not assert here as certain.

run_3_data_side_changes: Fix the confirmed missing-ABI_ACCEPTED_ORDINAL:-prefix bug (B2_PRIOR_OVERRIDE, B5, partially B1) with a stronger, example-bearing instruction: 'Example: if the value is 7, respond ABI_ACCEPTED_ORDINAL:7 -- always include the prefix, never the bare number.' Cheap, already-understood, high-confidence fix.

Concentrate the large majority of run-3 data/epoch budget on the 3 genuine-judgment B6 families rather than spreading it thin across families the resolver now handles with 100% reliability regardless of what the model does.

B1's cross-family confusion (echoing B0_READ) becomes low-priority for PRODUCTION purposes once CODEBOOK_LOOKUP handles B1 deterministically -- the model's B1 answer is never actually consulted. Worth a light research note, not a training-budget priority.
concrete_hybrid_design.what_this_achieves: If the resolver covers B0_READ/B0_WRITE/B1/B2 (all three)/B3 (both)/B4/B5/B6_GWT (both) -- 12 of 16 families -- at effectively 100% deterministic reliability regardless of the model's own accuracy on them, and run 3's data budget concentrates on genuinely lifting the remaining 3-4 judgment families, the SYSTEM (harness+model together, exactly the framing the owner specified) can plausibly reach near-complete reliable coverage without needing the 0.8B core to ever get better at tasks it was never well-suited to learn in the first place.

open_verification_items_for_chatgpt_when: Is B6_HYPERPOSITION_EVIDENCE_AUTHORITY actually reducible to a fixed rule ('majority-vote-type pressure never collapses branches') the way GWT/CODEBOOK families are, or does it genuinely require weighing evidence quality per-episode? This determines whether it moves from 'model-trained judgment family' to a 4th deterministic solver.

Is the ARITHMETIC_COMPARISON solver's predicate-phrasing coverage actually exhaustive against the real B0_READ generator's template set, or are there phrasings this session didn't sample that would silently fall through to 'no match, use the model' in a way that quietly reintroduces the original bug?

Sanity-check the CODEBOOK_WITH_OVERRIDE precedence logic (STALE check first, then authoritative-block selection, then UPDATE application) against edge cases not directly observed this session -- e.g. a STALE codebook that ALSO has an UPDATE statement -- to make sure the stated order is actually unambiguous in the real generator's full row space, not just the handful of rows read here.
runs_used_note: This concept does not itself consume a Together run -- it is preparation for how run 3's data-side changes should be scoped (small, targeted) BEFORE spending it, and for what should be handled by the harness instead of training at all. 3 of 5 authorized Together runs remain untouched.
